mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear 71 degrees at Fireman's Park under a third quarter moon. If you are up early, look toward the northwest over the high school at 4:19 AM to see the International Space Station traveling toward Fitchburg, reaching halfway up the sky.

The city has officially installed a new public art piece called the Tai Chi Animal Frolics tree in Century School Park. Carved by local artists from a reclaimed ash tree, this seven-foot sculpture honors traditional Tai Chi movements and is a wonderful addition to our local arts scene.

There is plenty to do in our community, including Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today and Hop Haus Trivia this Thursday. Looking ahead, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow.

On August 30, officers were dispatched to the 800 block of North Edge Trail following reports of a vehicle window being intentionally smashed, and an arrest warrant has since been issued for the suspect.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The local Culver's is currently closed, but they will open today at 10:00 AM to start serving up fresh scoops.
